extraction: Embedded base64 bytes from the package. The two paintings were re-encoded from the original PNG to WebP quality 95 at unchanged pixel dimensions (#245), then to WebP quality 90 with a 1024 px longest side, then to AVIF at unchanged dimensions (#607), and finally decoded from that AVIF and encoded as opaque lossy VP8 WebP with an 800 px longest side (#770). Each file's priorDerivatives lists that chain newest first; cropping happens at render time.
artworkRights: User-supplied design assets used for the requested isolated mock repair. The package does not name an artist or independent redistribution license; production rights review remains required.
